snippet.title: Triple Realms - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Build, merge and expand your kingdom in Triple Realms, a low-poly 3D roguelite combining strategic puzzles with village building and long-term progression.

Place buildings and props on a grid and merge them to evolve your village. Each successful merge earns experience and helps unlock powerful upgrades for your current run as you discover new structures and increasingly powerful combinations.

Expand your empire one village at a time and develop your capital city to unlock permanent power-ups, opening up new possibilities for future runs and long-term strategic planning.

Play the demo and wishlist Triple Realms now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4365750/Triple_Realms/
